flows:
Navigate to https://www.onlineconversion.com/length_common.htm then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In Common Length and Distance Conversions, assert that the To unit list fits entirely within the 320-pixel viewport.
Without horizontal scrolling, enter 1, choose feet in From and inch in To, and activate Convert.
Verify the result reads 1 feet = 12 inch.
